subject: general
question:
**Consider the following statements about Pranav Soorma's performance at the Khelo India Para Games 2023:**

1. He broke his own previous club throw record of 30.01m.

2. He set a new Asian record with a throw of 33.54m.

Which of the above statements** is/are correct?**
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are correct**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Statement 1:** Pranav Soorma broke his own previous club throw record of **30.01m**. This achievement highlights his exceptional performance and ability to surpass his earlier milestones. ***Hence, Statement 1 is correct.*** 
• **Statement 2:** Pranav Soorma set a new **Asian record** with a throw of **33.54m**. This record emphasizes his prowess at the regional level, showcasing his dominance in the sport. ***Hence, Statement 2 is correct.*** 
• The **Khelo India Para Games** is a platform to encourage and recognize athletes with disabilities, providing them opportunities to showcase their talent. 
• Pranav Soorma's performance not only brought him individual recognition but also contributed to India's growing reputation in para-sports.
